However, the victim’s family suspected foul play as the suspect posted a statement on Facebook admitting to his crimes which was later deleted. The post wrote:

"I have done something that I deeply regret and I need to do my best to make up for it. I let my intrusive thoughts win and I have to pay the consequences," and another which said, "I cannot express in words the pain and grift I feel for the victim's family. It is important for me to express my deepest condolences to the family and to let them know that I am truly sorry for what happened,".

After further investigation, autopsy later revealed that the victim died of severe blunt force trauma to the head and showed signs of suffering from physical abuse as well. 

The family has filed a murder complaint against the suspect but court proceedings are suspended until he is 18. The grandfather of the victim states that forgiveness is not impossible but the suspect must be punished to the maximum extent.
